crossRefs.note: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.
Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
Therefore a battle roar will arise among your people, and all your fortresses will be destroyed, as Shalman destroyed…
Yet was she carried away. She went into captivity. Her young children also were dashed in pieces at the head of all the…
They ravished the women in Zion, the virgins in the cities of Judah.
For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city will be taken, the houses rifled, and the women…

translations.web: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.
translations.bsb: Their infants will be dashed to pieces before their eyes, their houses will be looted, and their wives will be ravished.
translations.kjv: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
translations.asv: Their infants also shall be dashed in pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be rifled, and their wives ravished.
